Why is Krishna called Ranchhod, the one who ran from battle? As the story goes, a fearsome warrior, Kalayavana, attacked Mathura. He had a boon. No weapon could kill him.
So Krishna did something strange. He turned around, and ran. Kalayavana laughed and chased him. Out of the city, over the hills, and into a dark cave.
Inside, someone was sleeping. Kalayavana thought it was Krishna, and kicked him. But it was King Muchukunda, who had a boon of his own. Whoever woke him would burn.

Wait, what happened? Muchukunda opened his eyes, and Kalayavana turned to ashes. Krishna didn't need a weapon. He needed a plan. That's why he is lovingly called Ranchhod. Comment Ranchhod if you knew this.
